text: A graphics processing unit runs thousands of threads in parallel, which makes it well suited to matrix multiplication.
Large language models spend most of their decoding time moving weights from memory to the compute units.
Quantisation stores weights with fewer bits and rescales them on the fly, trading a little accuracy for a smaller footprint.
A key value cache stores the attention keys and values of earlier tokens so they need not be recomputed.
Continuous batching lets a server add new requests to a running batch as soon as other requests finish.
Speculative decoding drafts several tokens cheaply and verifies them with the large model in one pass.
The learning rate usually warms up for a few hundred steps and then decays along a cosine curve.
Gradient clipping limits the norm of the gradient so a single bad batch cannot destroy the weights.
Low rank adaptation freezes the base weights and trains two thin matrices whose product is added to a layer.
A checkpoint records the weights and the optimiser state so that training can resume after an interruption.
Distillation trains a small student model to match the output distribution of a larger teacher model.
Pruning removes whole attention heads or hidden channels and then recovers quality with further training.
Evaluation should compare a compressed model with its parent on the same prompts and report uncertainty.
Content addressed storage names every blob by the hash of its bytes, so identical data is stored only once.
A kernel is a small program that runs on the graphics processor and is launched over a grid of thread blocks.
The roofline model says that performance is limited either by memory bandwidth or by peak arithmetic throughput.
Tokens are the pieces of text a model reads; a tokenizer maps strings to integers and back.
Mixed precision training keeps master weights in high precision while the heavy matrix products run in fewer bits.
When a loss value suddenly spikes, a robust trainer rolls back to the last good checkpoint and lowers the learning rate.
Reproducible experiments record seeds, library versions and hardware so that a result can be checked later.
Shared memory is a small, fast scratchpad on each streaming multiprocessor that threads in a block can use together.
Rotary position embeddings encode the position of a token by rotating pairs of query and key channels.
Grouped query attention shares each key and value head among several query heads to shrink the cache.
Stochastic rounding rounds up or down at random with probability proportional to the distance, so the mean is unbiased.
A prefix cache reuses the key value blocks of a shared system prompt across many different requests.
Weights packed as four bit integers must be unpacked and converted before the tensor cores can use them.
A good smoke test is small enough to run in a minute and still touches every stage of the pipeline.
Garbage collection in a content addressed store keeps everything reachable from a pinned artifact and removes the rest.
The hidden size, the number of layers and the vocabulary size determine most of a model's parameter count.
Batch size trades throughput against latency: larger batches use the hardware better but make each user wait longer.
Calibration data for quantisation should resemble the text the deployed model will see.
Noise between repeated evaluations sets the smallest difference that can be called a real improvement.
Memory bandwidth, not arithmetic, usually limits single stream decoding on modern accelerators.
A web interface can stream progress to the browser with server sent events over a plain HTTP connection.
Fine tuning on a few thousand good examples can change the style of a model without teaching it new facts.
Long context evaluation inserts a fact deep in a long document and asks the model to retrieve it later.
Each rented GPU hour costs money, so cheap validation steps should run before the expensive ones.
Hadamard rotations spread outliers across channels, which can make low bit quantisation easier.
Sparse attention lets each query attend to a small selected subset of earlier tokens instead of all of them.
The best configuration file is short, commented and validated against a schema before a job starts.
